info.name: E-Commerce Transactional Core
info.description: Order -> Inventory -> Payment saga via API Gateway. Run folders 00-07 in order with the Collection Runner. Select the 'Shop - Local' environment first. See docs/TESTING.md.

exec: // Mint DEV-ONLY HS256 JWTs (same shared secret as the gateway's application.yml) so no identity provider is needed.
const body = enc({ sub: sub, iat: now, exp: now + ttlSeconds, scope: 'orders' });
return head + '.' + body + '.' + b64url(CryptoJS.HmacSHA256(head + '.' + body, secret));

item.name: 00 - Smoke & Infrastructure
item.description: Run these first. If any fail, see the troubleshooting table in docs/TESTING.md.

exec: pm.test('Stock payload', () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.sku).to.eql('SKU-CASE-BLK'); pm.expect(b.available).to.be.a('number'); });
pm.test('Stock recorded: available=' + b.available + ' reserved=' + b.reserved, () => pm.expect(b.available).to.be.at.least(1));
pm.test('PENDING, total recomputed server-side = 84999', () => { pm.expect(b.status).to.eql('PENDING'); pm.expect(b.totalAmount).to.eql(84999); });

item.name: 2.3 Replay SAME Idempotency-Key + same body -> 200, same order

request.description: Polls until the order is terminal. Expected final status: **CONFIRMED**. Requires the Collection Runner for auto-polling.

exec: // Collection Runner: wait 1.5s and re-send this same request. In single-send mode just click Send again.
pm.test('Order reached ' + expected + ' (after ' + tries + ' poll(s))', () => pm.expect(body.status).to.eql(expected));
pm.test('Payment SUCCEEDED with PSP reference', () => { pm.expect(b.status).to.eql('SUCCEEDED'); pm.expect(b.pspReference).to.match(/^psp_/); });
setTimeout(function () {}, 2500); // allow CommitReservation to be consumed by inventory
pm.test('reserved back to previous value (reservation committed)', () => pm.expect(b.reserved).to.eql(reservedBefore));

item.name: 03 - Failure paths & compensation
item.description: 3.7-3.9 take ~5-8 seconds: first PSP call times out at 3s, Resilience4j retries with the SAME Idempotency-Key.

exec: pm.test('202 Accepted (failure is discovered asynchronously)', () => pm.response.to.have.status(202));

request.description: Polls until the order is terminal. Expected final status: **CANCELLED**. Requires the Collection Runner for auto-polling.

exec: // Collection Runner: wait 1.5s and re-send this same request. In single-send mode just click Send again.
pm.test('Order reached ' + expected + ' (after ' + tries + ' poll(s))', () => pm.expect(body.status).to.eql(expected));
pm.test('failureReason is the PSP decline code', () => pm.expect(body.failureReason).to.eql('PSP_DECLINED'));
setTimeout(function () {}, 2500); // let the async Kafka commit/release command land before the next request
